embeds.title: Venice — $19.99 / month
embeds.description: Checkout runs on **zaeorion.com** with Stripe. Sign in with the **same Discord account** you use in this server, and stay in the server — your subscription is linked to that account.

fields.name: Free 7-day trial first
fields.value: No card needed. One per Discord account and one per PC. Start it on the [zaeorion.com](https://zaeorion.com/) home page.

fields.name: After checkout
fields.value: You get **no licence key**. The Venice bot grants Customer access and DMs your confirmation, then you unlock the app with a one-time code from [zaeorion.com/connect](https://zaeorion.com/connect) — one PC at a time, 3 free resets with `/hwid_reset`.

fields.name: Cancelling
fields.value: Any time in the [billing portal](https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/5kQ7sL0Ec4Ya5MfcFsgQE00). Access continues to the end of the period you have already paid for.

fields.name: Problems?
fields.value: Open a private ticket in **#create-ticket**. Never post a one-time code or payment details in a public channel.
